item.title: EIU baseball begins season with 26 returners
item.description: Eastern Illinois baseball returned five players due to an NCAA ruling allowing junior-college transfers whose eligibility was set to expire to receive an additional year. item.title: CHS girls basketball loses to Mattoon on senior night
item.description: Charleston girls’ basketball was unable to overcome a high-scoring first half from Mattoon and lost 67-40 on senior night in the final game of the regular season Thursday evening at Baker Gym. The Trojans (4-25, 0-10) found themselves trailing 52-16 going into halftime, but regrouped and outscored Mattoon (6-23, 2-8) 24-16 in the second half. ...
